references.text: Prohibition against having sexual relations with both a woman and her mother, called 'zimmah' (shameful act) - the same Hebrew expression is used in both verses
Parallel death penalty for family sins - here for cursing one's parents
Curse upon the one who lies with his mother-in-law - related prohibition within marital relationships
Burning as punishment for sexual sin - a priest's daughter committing adultery is punished by fire, same method of execution
Judah orders Tamar to be burned for adultery - early example of burning as punishment for sexual immorality
Achan is burned with fire for his sin - burning as a method of punishment for serious offenses in Israel
